proposals.issue_title: Silent Image Generation Failures and Low-Quality Fallbacks
proposals.current_pain_description: HF and Gemini images fail, AI Horde blocks GH Actions, and Pollinations outputs low-quality images without reference capabilities. Pipelines run blindly, consuming GH Actions minutes and committing low-quality/corrupted images to the repository.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a centralized Python abstraction helper `image_gen_gatekeeper.py`. It should implement a strict fallback chain (Together AI FLUX-schnell -> Cloudflare Workers AI FLUX -> Runware PAYG if budget allows -> Fail gracefully instead of committing Pollinations garbage). It must raise explicit exceptions on HTTP 429/403/500 to halt downstream processing immediately.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 100% of GitHub Actions minutes wasted on broken runs; ensures zero garbage assets are committed.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Automated Visual Quality Control (Blind Commits)
proposals.current_pain_description: Images generated via API can have broken anatomy, severe text gibberish, inverted colors (black backgrounds in coloring books), or empty canvas issues. Hugo must manually inspect everything on his phone, wasting his 10 hours/week.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate the free Gemini 2.5 Flash vision capability in `agent_gemini_quality_check`. Pass every generated image to Gemini with a strict system prompt checking for: 1) Inverted colors (for coloring books, must be white background), 2) Text spelling errors, 3) Visual artifacts. Return a JSON score; reject and regenerate if score < 8/10.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces manual filtering time by 90%, ensuring only ready-to-sell assets reach Hugo's phone.

proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo only has an Android phone. Manually downloading raw images, copying SEO tags, writing descriptions, and uploading them to Redbubble, KDP, or Cults3D on a mobile browser is incredibly slow and error-prone.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement an automated 'Mobile Distribution Packager' utility. For every completed product, generate a unified ZIP archive containing: 1) The optimized assets, 2) A `metadata.json` / `metadata.txt` with pre-formatted, copy-pasteable Titles, Tags (comma-separated), and Descriptions optimized for the target platform's mobile UI layout.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Cuts listing time per product on mobile from 15 minutes to under 3 minutes.

proposals.current_pain_description: Assets are generated for a single pipeline and left there. A high-quality line art drawing created for `produce_coloring_book` is not reused, despite being highly valuable as a standalone SVG vector pack or a Cricut cut-file.
proposals.proposed_fix: Build a `cross_pollinator.py` script. When a high-quality line-art PNG is approved by the quality check, auto-route it to: 1) Potrace (free CLI utility) to vectorize it into a clean SVG, 2) Package it as an SVG/DXF cut-file bundle for Etsy, 3) Add it as a transparent PNG transparent sticker design for Redbubble.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: 3x the product listings (Etsy SVG pack, Redbubble stickers, KDP coloring pages) from a single API generation cost.

proposals.issue_title: Termux vs. GitHub Actions Dependency Drift
proposals.current_pain_description: Scripts developed or tested in Termux on Android often fail silently or crash when run in GitHub Actions due to missing system-level libraries (e.g., `libGL`, `OpenCV`, `Cairo`, `WeasyPrint` dependencies, or Python PIL library differences).
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a lightweight `env_sanitizer.py` pre-flight script. Run it as the first step in both Termux and GitHub Actions workflows to verify Python package versions, system binaries (like `potrace` or `openscad`), and write-permissions, failing fast with a clear debug log if a mismatch is found.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates 'works on my phone but fails on GitHub' debugging loops that drain Hugo's weekly hours.

proposals.issue_title: GitHub Actions Execution Timeout and State Loss
proposals.current_pain_description: Generating a full 40-page coloring book or low-content book requires multiple API calls and image downloads. If a GitHub Action runner times out or gets canceled, all progress is lost, wasting API costs and execution time.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement an incremental state-saving mechanism using GitHub Actions Cache or automatic Git branch commits. After every 5 successfully generated and checked pages, commit the partial progress (`state.json` + raw images) to a draft branch so the pipeline can resume where it left off on the next run.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Zero wasted API costs or runner time on interrupted multi-page book compilations.
